GreetingKit.swiftmodule / GreetingKit.swiftinterface provenance

Source: Greeting.swift (benign struct/enum/class with typed fields and methods,
plus lowercaseBox/PayloadTag, which deliberately break Swift naming convention).

Compiler: Swift version 6.3.2 (swift-6.3.2-RELEASE), target x86_64-unknown-windows-msvc.

Command (run in this directory):
  swiftc -emit-module \
    -emit-module-path GreetingKit.swiftmodule \
    -emit-module-interface-path GreetingKit.swiftinterface \
    -enable-library-evolution -swift-version 6 \
    -module-name GreetingKit Greeting.swift

swiftmodule_dewall.rs re-runs that exact command when swiftc is on PATH and
requires the freshly built module to yield the same identifier table as the
committed fixture, so the two files cannot drift apart silently.

GreetingKit.swiftmodule is a real Swift serialized module: 4-byte signature
0xE2 0x9C 0xA8 0x0E followed by a standard LLVM bitstream. swiftmodule.rs reads
the IDENTIFIER_DATA block (block id 12), a single NUL-separated blob.

What that blob actually is
--------------------------
It is the module's identifier string table, NOT the set of declarations. For
this fixture it holds 36 entries: the 17 names the .swiftinterface declares plus
19 entries that are not declarations of this module. swiftmodule_dewall.rs
compares the two sets in both directions and names every one of the 19, in five
categories:

  class initializer mangled symbols (2)
    $s11GreetingKit14CourierServiceC12channelLabelACSS_tcfc and the ...cfC
    allocating form. Both demangle to CourierService.init(channelLabel:).

  argument labels and parameter names (5)
    a, b from ==(a:b:); into, hasher from hash(into hasher:); greeting from
    enqueueGreeting(_ greeting:).

  implicit setter parameter (1)
    value. Compiling a module whose only content is a class with one settable
    stored property emits exactly ['$s...cfc', '$s...cfC', 'CourierService',
    'pendingMessages', 'value', 'Swift', 'Int', 'Copyable', 'Escapable'], which
    is where this entry comes from.

  synthesized Hashable witness (2)
    _rawHashValue and its seed: parameter. Compiling a module whose only content
    is `public enum DeliveryChannel { case inbox }` emits both; compiling a
    module with no enum emits neither.

  names of decls in imported modules (7) and implicit protocols (2)
    Swift, String, Int, Bool, Hasher, Equatable, Hashable are referenced, not
    declared. Copyable and Escapable are the implicit Swift 6 layout protocols
    every nominal type conforms to; they appear for a module as small as one
    struct and are never printed in an interface.

type_like_identifiers / member_like_identifiers split on the first character's
case alone. lowercaseBox (a struct) and PayloadTag (a stored property) are in
the fixture so that limitation is asserted rather than hidden.

Scope: this recovers declared symbol / type / member NAMES, not Swift
function-body source.
